verdicts.reason: Both mix alignments: the headline and teal tagline are left-aligned while the body copy, dividers and contact lines are centred. Both leave large dead gaps between the dividers, and the booking/website lines are tiny and hard to read. A's larger body copy fills the tall canvas a little better, though 'creativity.' sits alone on its own line. B keeps the original two-line wrap, but its smaller body text floats in even more empty space.
